# MetalPrices.online — Full Reference

> Live precious metals spot price tracker with country-specific import duty, GST, and VAT calculator for Gold, Silver, Platinum, and Palladium across 13 countries. Prices update every 60 seconds from international commodity exchanges via TradingView market feeds.

## Metals Tracked

- **Gold (XAU)**: Safe haven asset. Purities: 24K (99.9%), 22K (91.6%), 18K (75.0%), 14K (58.3%), 10K (41.7%)
- **Silver (XAG)**: Industrial and monetary metal. Purities: Fine Silver (99.9%), Sterling (92.5%), Coin Silver (90.0%)
- **Platinum (XPT)**: Automotive catalysts and jewelry
- **Palladium (XPD)**: Electronics and autocatalysts

## Currencies Supported

USD, INR, EUR, GBP, AED, JPY, CAD, AUD, CHF, CNY, RUB, IDR, ZAR

## Weight Units

Troy ounce (oz), gram (g), kilogram (kg), tola (10g), tael (37.5g), baht (15.244g), mesghal (4.6083g), pennyweight (dwt)

## Countries and Tax Rates

| Country | Currency | Import Duty (Gold) | VAT/GST (Gold) | Notes |
|---------|----------|-------------------|-----------------|-------|
| India | INR | 15% | 3% | Highest combined precious metals tax. Jewelry has additional 5% GST on making charges |
| United Arab Emirates | AED | 5% | 5% | Dubai Gold Souk is one of the world's largest retail gold markets |
| United States | USD | 0% | ~6% (varies by state) | Many states exempt investment-grade bullion from sales tax |
| United Kingdom | GBP | 0% | 20% | Investment gold coins and bars meeting HMRC criteria are VAT-exempt |
| Germany | EUR | 0% | 19% | EU investment gold of 99.5%+ purity is VAT-exempt |
| Canada | CAD | 0% | 0% | Investment-grade precious metals are GST/HST exempt |
| Australia | AUD | 0% | 0% | Investment-grade precious metals are GST exempt |
| Japan | JPY | 0% | 10% | TOCOM is the main price reference |
| Switzerland | CHF | 0% | 8.1% | Home to PAMP and Valcambi refineries |
| China | CNY | 0% | 13% | Shanghai Gold Exchange is the world's largest physical gold exchange |
| Russia | RUB | 0% | 20% | World's largest palladium producer |
| Indonesia | IDR | 7.5% | 11% | Antam is the state-owned gold producer |
| South Africa | ZAR | 0% | 15% | World's largest producer of platinum-group metals |

## Price Calculation Method

1. International spot price in USD per troy ounce is sourced from TradingView feeds
2. Converted to local currency using live exchange rates
3. Scaled to the selected weight unit (e.g., per gram = spot / 31.1035)
4. Import duty applied as percentage of the converted spot price
5. VAT/GST applied on (spot + import duty) base
6. Final price = spot + import duty + VAT/GST

## Calculator Features

- Weight-based pricing for any quantity
- Product format selection: Bullion (coins/bars) vs. Jewelry
- Purity/fineness selection per metal
- Optional VAT/GST inclusion toggle
- Mint fee / markup override
- Premium override percentage
- Country tax profile auto-detection via IP geolocation

## API Endpoint

- Base URL: https://api.metalprices.online
- Authentication: Token-based (fetch /token first, pass as X-Token header)
- Snapshot endpoint: /snapshot (returns current quotes for all metals and FX rates)

## URL Structure

- Home: /
- Metal by country: /{country-slug}/{metal}
  - Example: /india/gold, /united-states/silver, /united-arab-emirates/platinum
- Country overview: /{country-slug}/
  - Example: /india/, /united-kingdom/
- Blogs: /blogs
- Tips: /tips

## Country Slugs

india, united-arab-emirates, united-states, united-kingdom, germany, canada, australia, japan, switzerland, china, russia, indonesia, south-africa

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is the gold price today?**
The live gold spot price updates every 60 seconds on MetalPrices.online, sourced from international commodity exchanges. The homepage shows the current price in USD, INR, EUR, and 10+ other currencies.

**What is the GST on gold in India?**
GST on gold in India is 3% on the gold value and 5% on making charges for jewelry. For gold bars and coins, GST is 3%.

**What is the import duty on gold in India?**
The basic customs duty on gold imported into India is 15%.

**How is the live gold price calculated in INR?**
The international spot price (USD per troy ounce) is converted to INR using the live USD/INR exchange rate, then scaled to per-gram or per-tola. Import duty of 15% is added to get the duty-paid price.

**What is the difference between 24K and 22K gold price?**
24K gold is 99.9% pure and commands the highest price. 22K gold is 91.6% pure, so its price is roughly 91.6% of 24K gold for the same weight.

## Technical Details

- Frontend: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite
- Hosting: Cloudflare Pages
- Data source: TradingView market feeds via custom API proxy
- Update frequency: Configurable 30s to 30min (default 60s)
- SEO: Static pre-rendered pages for all country/metal combinations with structured data (JSON-LD)
